faq.backups.a: In the backups folder inside {0}. The History tab lists them with an Undo button, and the app keeps the newest five per mod.
faq.cannot_check.a: The mod author did not put update information in the mod's manifest, so there is nothing to look up. You can still update such a mod: download it yourself and drop the .zip onto this window.
faq.collection.a: Yes. On the Profiles tab, paste the collection's address from nexusmods.com. Sprinkler reads its mod list, saves it as a profile, and offers the mods you do not have under Updates as installs. It never switches your mods by itself, and the optional mods are only added if you tick the box. With a free Nexus account you click once per mod; with Premium it is automatic.
faq.collection.q: Can I use a Nexus collection?
faq.missing_mod.a: Some mods need a framework mod, such as Content Patcher or SpaceCore. If it is not installed, SMAPI skips the mod without a clear message. The app finds these and offers to install them.
faq.profile.a: A saved list of which mods are switched on, for example one for solo play and one for co-op. Switching only adds or removes the leading dot on a mod's folder name, which is how SMAPI skips a mod, so nothing is moved or deleted. A shared profile lists mods, names and where to get them, never your settings or folders.
faq.remove_app.a: Delete the program and the folder {0}. If you turned on "Let this app handle Nexus links" or added the app to your menu, turn those off first under Nexus and settings.
faq.remove_app.q: How do I remove the app?
faq.removed_back.a: Yes. Removing a mod saves a backup of its folder first, and the removal appears in History with an Undo button that restores it with its settings.
faq.removed_back.q: Can I get a removed mod back?
faq.safe.a: Nothing changes until you press Update. Before a mod is replaced, its folder is saved as a zip, and every change can be undone from History. The app only talks to smapi.io, Nexus Mods, CurseForge and GitHub, and it never touches your save games.
faq.settings.a: No. Your config.json files are kept when a mod is updated, and save games are never touched. The one exception is a profile with "keeps its own mod settings" turned on, which puts back the settings it saved for that profile when you switch to it.
faq.settings.q: Will it change my settings or saves?
faq.why_click.a: Nexus only gives files to logged-in users, and a free account has to press the download button itself. The app opens the exact file page for you, then installs the file the moment it lands in your Downloads folder. With Nexus Premium and a saved key it is fully automatic.
faq.why_click.q: Why do I have to click on Nexus Mods?
fix.closed_game.a: Stardew Valley locks the files of the mods it loaded. Close the game and SMAPI, then try again.
fix.closed_game.q: The app says to close the game
fix.failed.a: The app puts the old version back when anything goes wrong, so nothing is left half-installed. The card says why. Try again, or pick another source on the card.
fix.key.a: Copy the "Personal API Key" again from nexusmods.com/settings/api-keys and paste it without spaces.
fix.key.q: Nexus did not accept my key
fix.smapi.a: Mods only load through SMAPI. Install it from smapi.io, then press Check again.
fix.window.a: Start the app from a terminal and send what it prints with a problem report. Under Linux, mention your desktop and whether it runs on Wayland or X11.
fix.window.q: The window looks wrong or will not open

tour.1.text: It checks your mods against SMAPI's update list, shows what is out of date, and installs updates with a backup. This takes 30 seconds.
tour.1.title: Welcome to Sprinkler
tour.2.text: On launch the app reads your Mods folder and asks smapi.io which mods have newer versions. Nothing is changed during the check.
tour.2.title: 1. It checks for you
tour.3.text: Every update has a card. Tick the ones you want. The source buttons show where the file comes from, and "Automatic" ones need nothing from you.
tour.3.title: 2. You choose
tour.4.text: Mods that need a click open on Nexus a few at a time. When the file lands in Downloads, the app installs it. Every mod is backed up first.
tour.4.title: 3. Press Update
tour.5.text: Save which mods are switched on as a profile, for example solo, co-op or testing, and switch in one click. Share one with a friend as a small file.
tour.5.title: Profiles for different games
tour.6.text: History has an Undo button for every change, even removing a mod. When you are done, press Play to start the game through SMAPI.
tour.6.title: Undo any time
tour.7.text: A free Nexus key lets the app pick the exact file and show what changed. With Premium it downloads by itself. You will find it under Nexus and settings.
tour.7.title: Optional: connect Nexus

ui.three_steps_you_are_always_asked_befo: Three steps. You are always asked before anything changes.
ui.tick_the_updates_you_want_each_card_s: Tick the updates you want. Each card shows where the file comes from.
ui.tick_what_you_want_then_press_update: Tick what you want, then press Update
ui.use_nexus_mods_and_switch_to_cursefor: Use Nexus Mods, and switch to CurseForge or GitHub only if Nexus fails or you choose it.
ui.use_the_switch_to_turn_a_mod_off_or_o: Use the switch to turn a mod off or on. SMAPI skips a mod that is switched off. "Cannot check" means the author left update info out of the manifest. You can still update such a mod by dropping its downloaded file onto this window.
ui.when_you_download_a_mod_in_your_brows: When you download a mod in your browser, the app notices it here and installs it.
ui.wrong_folder_change_it_under_nexus_an: Wrong folder? Change it under Nexus and settings.
ui.you_click_mod_manager_download_on_nex: You click "Mod Manager Download" on Nexus, and the app does the rest.
ui.you_press_download_on_nexus_and_the_a: you press download on Nexus and the app installs the file from your Downloads folder.
ui.you_press_the_download_button_on_the_: You press the download button on the site. The app installs the file the moment it lands in your Downloads folder.
ui.you_see_the_plan_first_and_press_upda: You see the plan first and press Update yourself.
upd.b1: The download is checked against a signature built into this program, so a changed file is refused.
upd.b2: The new version is started once to make sure it works before it replaces this one.
upd.b3: Your mods, settings, profiles and backups are not touched.
upd.bad_hash: The download does not match its fingerprint, so it was not installed.
upd.bad_signature: The signature on this release does not match, so it was not installed.
upd.bad_sums: The signed list of file fingerprints is not valid.
upd.cannot_replace: This copy of Sprinkler cannot replace itself here. Open the release page and install the new version by hand.
upd.check: Look for a new version of Sprinkler when it starts
upd.check_note: Asks GitHub once at start which version is newest. Nothing else is sent. A new version is only installed after you say yes.
upd.confirm_text: Sprinkler downloads the new version, checks it, and restarts itself.
upd.network: The update could not be downloaded: {0}
upd.no_files: This release has no download for your system, or it is not signed. Open its page to get it.
upd.no_program: The download does not contain the program, so it was not installed.
upd.not_listed: The signed list does not mention this file, so it was not installed.
upd.restart_failed: Sprinkler is updated, but it could not restart itself. Start it again by hand.
upd.swap_failed: The new version could not be put in place ({0}). Nothing was changed.
upd.title: Updates to Sprinkler
upd.too_big: The download is larger than expected, so it was stopped.
upd.wont_start: The new version did not start correctly, so it was not installed. Nothing was changed.
vm.about: Sprinkler {0}. Free and open source (MIT). Update checks come from the SMAPI update service; downloads come from Nexus Mods, CurseForge and GitHub.
vm.backups_text: Backups use {0}. The app keeps the newest {1} per mod and removes older ones.
vm.choose_text_found: I found these installs. Pick the one whose mods you want to update.
vm.choose_text_none: I could not find it by myself. Paste the folder that contains "Stardew Valley.dll".
vm.finished_text: {0} You can undo any change from History.
vm.health_errors: Some mods reported errors last time you played
vm.health_skipped_one: {0} mod did not load last time you played
vm.health_skipped_other: {0} mods did not load last time you played
vm.health_sub: From SMAPI's own log of your last game session ({0}). {1} mods and {2} content packs loaded.
vm.hero_text_review: Review them below. Each mod is backed up first, and you can undo any change from History.
vm.smapi_missing: Not found. Install it from smapi.io, or mods will not load.
vm.smapi_update: SMAPI {0} is out (you have {1}). SMAPI has its own installer, so this app leaves it alone.
